solution: Replication supports fault tolerance: a site failure need not make all records unavailable. But every copy needs appropriate access controls; a weakly protected site can expose data, and incomplete deletion can leave personal records elsewhere. Coordinated updates/deletions and checks across replicas are needed to preserve consistency. Replication is useful for availability only when security and update consistency are managed across all sites.
